summary.headline: Hecto Innovation to buy back KRW 1.65bn of common shares on the open market, Nov 24, 2026 – Feb 23, 2027
summary.what_happened: Hecto Innovation Co., Ltd.'s board resolved on Nov 23, 2026 to acquire 128,634 common shares through direct on-exchange purchases via Shinhan Investment Corp., with an expected acquisition amount of KRW 1,645,228,860. The acquisition period runs from Nov 24, 2026 to Feb 23, 2027, and the stated purpose is shareholder value enhancement and employee compensation.

key_numbers.label: Treasury shares held before this decision

summary.why_it_matters: Share buyback decisions of this type are generally made to return value to shareholders or to fund employee compensation; repurchased shares may be cancelled, held in treasury, or used for other purposes, which can affect the number of shares outstanding. The actual amount and number of shares acquired may differ from the planned figures depending on future share price movements.
